data.action: 一手叉腰，另一手托着计算器平板与账单文件，鼓腮说教
data.description: 【早濑优香 · 夏莱办公室的说教与陪伴】夏莱总指挥室内，午后暖阳透过百叶窗洒下斑驳光影。优香一手叉腰站在老师的办公桌旁，另一手托着计算器平板和一叠被驳回的零食请款单，鼓起腮帮子故作威严地进行说教——「老师！怎么又偷偷买了这么多高价手办和点心！真拿老师没办法……这次的账目我帮您平了，但下不为例！」
data.lighting: 百叶窗透射的斜射暖阳与室内明亮荧光
data.promptProse: Yuuka stands beside the teacher’s office desk, one hand on her hip and the other holding the calculator tablet and rejected snack receipts. Keep the navy blazer, white blouse and blue tie in the cowboy view as she puffs her cheeks in mock sternness. The near desk edge overlaps the papers; a filing cabinet and the office’s blind-covered window occupy the farther wall behind her. Afternoon sunlight through the blinds stripes the desktop and lanyard. Bright room light keeps the shaded face and receipts readable, with a softer cabinet-side shadow and darker gaps between the blinds retaining the room’s depth.
data.title: 早濑优香 · 夏莱办公室的说教与陪伴
